top_moves.title: Google's Gemini free-tier cut takes effect today: free personal accounts drop to Flash-Lite only
top_moves.body: Personal accounts without a Google AI plan lose Flash and Pro as of today; AI Plus ($4.99) keeps Flash but loses Pro on per-account dates Google will email, and AI Pro ($19.99) gains Deep Think. Work and school accounts are not mentioned in the coverage, and Google's limits page still lists Deep Think as Ultra-only, so the rollout looks incomplete.

top_moves.title: OpenAI rolls GPT-6 and "Intelligent UI" into ChatGPT across all tiers
top_moves.body: Paid tiers got GPT-6 on Oct 7 with Free and Go scheduled for Oct 8 (not yet confirmed as landed); replies can now embed charts, buttons, forms and calculators when the question suits it. Reports say paid plans run **GPT-6 Sol** and Free/Go run **GPT-6 Luna**; Enterprise access depends on admin settings, and Work and Codex models are unchanged.

top_moves.title: NIST SP 1353 comment window closes in six days
top_moves.body: The draft Quick-Start Guide on using generative AI for CSF 2.0 analysis, planning and reporting treats every AI-generated mapping as "Proposed/Derived" until a qualified human reviews it. That human-review rule is a ready-made control statement for any client using AI in resilience or compliance documentation; confirm the deadline at csrc.nist.gov.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI roll out in ChatGPT: paid tiers Oct 7, Free and Go scheduled Oct 8
providers.detail: ChatGPT replies can now mix text with interactive charts, buttons, forms and task-specific tools; users can dial the visual material down. Reports put paid plans on GPT-6 Sol and Free/Go on GPT-6 Luna, with GPT-6 Astra still limited to selected organizations. The rollout is phased and Enterprise availability depends on workspace admin settings. All of this comes from secondary coverage (TechCrunch briefing, trade sites); model naming differs between sources.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Free-tier cut lands today: free personal accounts get Flash-Lite only; AI Plus loses Pro on emailed dates
providers.detail: From Oct 9, personal accounts without a Google AI plan lose Flash and Pro. AI Plus keeps Flash-Lite and Flash but loses Pro on per-account dates nobody has yet seen in writing. AI Pro gains Deep Think, and low/medium/high effort levels are being added (higher effort burns more of the usage limit). Where Gemini 4 Argon fits in the tiering is still unclear.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Single-source report of a Mistral Large 4 preview on Oct 6, via the API, with open weights promised later this year
providers.detail: One outlet reports Mistral launched a Large 4 preview on Oct 6 on its API platform ahead of a full open-weight release later in 2026. No second outlet or Mistral changelog entry confirms it yet, so treat it as unverified. If real, it matters for clients who need an EU-headquartered or self-hostable flagship model.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: October wave continues: Edge Copilot redesign (MC1484007) goes GA mid-October; PowerPoint Copilot keeps working after the app closes
providers.detail: The Edge change adopts a new icon at every Copilot entry point and simplifies the side pane; it rolls out automatically with no admin action. PowerPoint Copilot will continue long jobs after you close the app, switch devices or go offline, and Brand Kit gets Skills this month. Word's consolidated Word Agent entry point reaches GCC/DoD in October. SharePoint Copilot October updates were posted Oct 1.
